evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Text-to-SQL systems over large pooled catalogs must first retrieve the tables a question needs.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We compare against the published table recall of RASL, which uses Claude 3.5 models to extract keywords and select tables, on pooled BIRD, Spider, and Fiben catalogs.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: On 121 real BEAVER questions, without BEAVER fitting, its recall at fifteen (82.1) falls between two BEAVER-trained retrievers (80.8, 84.5), but its complete@15 is below both (49.6 vs 54.5 and 62.0).
